o: A band of toys rise to defend the enchanted Toylight, the last flicker of a child's imagination.

eps.o: Six grizzled toys reunite to guard the sacred nursery Toylight.

eps.t: Run, Run, As Fast As You Can
eps.o: The toys reconnoiter, have an angelic encounter, and send a diplomatic envoy to enemy lines.

eps.t: The Worms Crawl In, The Worms Crawl Out
eps.o: The Dark Prince of the Ratkin lays siege to the Nursery as the Toys attempt to hold the line.
The battle for Port Cochere and the Train Station continues.
